slides.headline: Here are some of my thoughts about sourdough and why it is so important for every single home baker out there today
Patience
slides.body: When it comes to sourdough it is really important to understand that your bread is not just about the flour and water you put in but about the journey you go on as a baker and the impact that it has on your kitchen and on your life and on your family in this ever-evolving landscape.

slides.headline: My morning routine
slides.body: Coffee, a walk with the dog, journaling.
